extracted.name: Crab Spread
extracted.description: This crab spread recipe features a block of cream cheese topped with crab and tangy cocktail sauce for a simple Fifties favorite party appetizer.
instruction_lines: Place the block of cream cheese on a serving plate or shallow dish. Top evenly with crabmeat, then squeeze the juice of one lemon over the crab.
Pour cocktail sauce over the top, covering the crab and cream cheese completely.
Serve immediately with crackers for dipping.
